what_happened.line: The Finance Committee set the public hearing and its recommendation votes on the draft special town meeting articles for October 13th.
The committee went through the first draft of the warrant articles; no formal vote on any article was taken, and most dollar amounts are not yet known.
The town manager said new growth and cherry sheet figures are awaited, and that free cash is not yet certified, so funding sources for the articles are open.
The stabilization article is to come after the other appropriation articles in the final order, since it takes whatever is left over.
The chair said updated dates for fall pre-budget presentations by assessors, DPW, the superintendent, police and fire would be emailed.

why_it_matters: The articles the committee reviewed are the spending requests residents will be asked to vote on at special town meeting, and the funding source for each, free cash or a stabilization fund, was still undecided at this meeting.
Several articles had no price yet, including a police contract, a park and school air conditioning, so the amounts voters see may differ from what was discussed here.
watch_next: October 13th public hearing, where the committee is to vote its recommendations on the articles.
An emailed schedule of fall pre-budget presentations from the chair, and a firm price for the primary school air conditioning expected by October 10th.
